review_candidates.title: Cluster Director of IT
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? The Cluster Director of Information Technology will lead the IT teams across both resorts and will be responsible for driving operational excellence, cybersecurity, innovation, infrastructure reliability, business continuity, and guest technology services while supporting the evolving technology needs of a luxury hospitality environment. Minimum 8–10 years of IT experience within large-scale hospitality, luxury hotels, resorts, or multinational environments, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
